data.raw_text:
As a Filipino, I'm straight-up disappointed in the brain rot hitting our youth right now. Siargao locals and online "activists" calling to BAN Israelis? Really? These kids are turning a surfing paradise into a battlefield over something happening 10,000 km away. Newsflash: Tourists aren't the IDF, and banning an entire nationality because of TikTok propaganda is peak stupidity. 🇵🇭🤦‍♂️

Let's be real. Yes, some tourists (ANY tourists) can be loud, entitled, or trash the place. Enforce the laws, fine them, kick out the bad apples. But screaming "settler colonization" and "ban all Israelis" over a Chabad House or post-military surfers? That's not justice that's collective punishment and straight-up racism dressed as "Free Palestine." Siargao isn't Gaza. Israelis were surfing Cloud 9 long before it blew up. They helped put us on the map.

This brain rot is economic suicide too. Israelis spend real money here. Resorts, food, tours that's jobs for Pinoys. Drive them away and watch your local businesses beg. Thailand didn't "ban" anyone and they're thriving. Meanwhile our youth is busy virtue-signaling on social media while ignoring our own problems: traffic in Manila, corruption, or actual issues in Mindanao. Prioritize, guys.

I'm Filipino and I stand with Israel because facts > feelings. The youth swallowing one-sided propaganda without context is embarrassing. Support Palestine? Fine. But don't harass tourists or destroy Siargao's vibe in the process. Siargao is for everyone who respects the place  not a political playground. #SiargaoForAll #Philippines #israel #Hamas #StopTheBrainRot #ProudPinoy #siargao #woke #antisemitic
